title: Casino
content: If anyone wondered why the roulette table shut down, I’m the guilty party. 30 black lol. Also saw Tom Welling walking around. I was headed across the room to meet him when I spilled my chips and had to pick them up causing me to stay at the table and then my number hit (I think 30 is red “here”) so they shut the table down. It was a big bet. Sorry, not sorry. 🍀
